caseStudies.title: Legacy Monolith Migration to Spring Cloud Microservices
caseStudies.problem: A client had a heavy, single-instance legacy enterprise platform suffering from single-point-of-failure downtimes and slow release cycles.
caseStudies.solution: Deconstructed the core domains into isolated Spring Boot microservices using Eureka for discovery, Spring Cloud Gateway for routing, and Docker for containerized deployment.

sections.heading: Core Architecture Specs
